read_contract.freshness_rule: On-demand read; live at this path with single-writer mutations through protected PRs against dev; never a mandatory entry surface (the mandatory agent entry surface is exactly /specs/root-hub-pointers.json#agent_entry_surface_allowlist).

_meta.purpose: KINETIC layer (Palantir Foundry 3-layer model): write-side action types + workflows. Mutations on the graph: create/update/promote/deprecate/archive/retire. WHAT THINGS DO. Each action has typed signature + audit emission + idempotency contract + lock pattern.
sibling_layers: /specs/products/ontology.json#type_system (type definitions; migrated from deleted registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json per ADR-0139)
_meta.palantir_analog: Action Types + Workflows in Palantir Foundry Ontology

CreateArtifact.purpose: Register a new machine-readable artifact in the capability registry.

PromoteCapabilityStatus.purpose: Lifecycle promotion of a capability declaration: planned → operational (or downgrade).

DeprecateBlock.purpose: Mark a reusable building block as deprecated; consumers redirect to replacement.

EmitEvidenceBundle.purpose: Emit a capability invocation / runbook execution / IP merge evidence bundle per evidence-bundle-template.

CloseIncident.purpose: Close an operational incident and emit the graph-traversable root-cause chain Incident -> CausedByChange -> PullRequest.

LandConsensusVerdict.purpose: Record codex consensus round verdict (APPROVE / ITERATE / REJECT) for a plan; updates plan verification_status.

WireLane.purpose: Flip a CI fitness lane status from planned to active (or vice versa).

ArchiveArtifact.purpose: Move artifact row from active registry to archive (e.g., superseded plan, retired markdown).

BumpPlanVersion.purpose: Increment plan version (vN.M.P → vN.M.(P+1)) after closing critic/architect fixes.

AddRegistryRow.purpose: Append a new row to a registry (e.g., new ADR, new BC, new microservice, new block).

UpdateCapabilityOverride.purpose: Update a sparse capability_override on an artifact capability-registry row without changing artifact_profile.

RetireMarkdown.purpose: Migrate a Markdown file to a machine-readable equivalent + delete the source.
RetireMarkdown.lock_pattern: source path + target path + retirement-ledger row
RetireMarkdown.post_action_required: Update all inbound citations from CI check crates + ADRs + plans

ClaimOyaVcs.purpose: Open an Oya VCS agent-coordination claim on a file/symbol identifier.
ClaimOyaVcs.lock_pattern: Oya VCS ChangeBundle + admission-gate concurrent-safe paths
ClaimOyaVcs.known_failure_mode: Manual PR-entry Wave-B seam before webhook receiver deployment per ADR-0116

DoneOyaVcs.purpose: Close an Oya VCS claim after verify/done/promote; releases locks through Promotion/ReleaseTrain closure.

RecordICMStore.purpose: Persist agent context to ICM (Infinite Context Memory).

consensus_loop.purpose: Multi-round architect+critic Linus-grade consensus on a plan.
actions_in_order: if-both-APPROVE: AddRegistryRow status=Accepted else BumpPlanVersion + repeat

markdown_retirement_per_file.purpose: Migrate one Markdown file to JSON form.

wave_acceptance.purpose: Drive a wave plan from pending approval → Accepted.

capability_promotion.purpose: Promote a capability from planned → operational once evidence lands.
actions_in_order: AddRegistryRow (evidence: crate path in HEAD; lane status=active; green CI run URL)

incident_closeout.purpose: Close incident records through a graph-traversable root-cause PR chain instead of prose-only troubleshooting notes.
incident_closeout.stop_condition: Incident status=closed, evidence_ref exists, and I16 root-cause PR chain validates.
